dct_description_sm: An archive of 2D regional seismic and long period magnetotelluric data collected during 20 years of work under the LITHOPROBE project. Data are primarily onshore and cover widespread regions of Canada. Available data types include raw digital data, processed sections, and images of final sections, as well as auxiliary information required for analysis of the data.
dct_title_s: Slave-Northern Cordillera Lithospheric Evolution magnetotelluric site 260a
